items.briefing:
New research from Commvault finds that one in three organisations in Australia and New Zealand still pay ransomware demands, despite guidance discouraging this practice. This is a timely reminder given that a cyberattack on logistics firm Ceva has now spread across its supply chain partners — a reminder that your organisation's security can be affected by the vendors and services you rely on.

Separately, Twitch has confirmed it is using content from streamers' broadcasts to train Amazon's AI systems, raising data privacy questions worth considering if your staff use the platform.

**Practical tip:** Review which third-party vendors have access to your systems and confirm they have adequate cybersecurity practices in place.

featured.title: One in three ANZ organisations still pay ransomware demands, Commvault research says
featured.quote: One in three ANZ organisations still paying ransomware demands reveals critical vulnerability in Australian business resilience.
